fields.name: Title
fields.label: Message Box Title
fields.description: The title text displayed at the top of the message box.

fields.name: Message
fields.label: Message to Display
fields.description: The main content of the message box (supports string, DataTable, or any object).

fields.name: Icon
fields.label: Message Box Icon
fields.description: The icon to be displayed in the message box.

fields.name: Buttons
fields.label: Message Box Buttons
fields.description: The buttons to display in the message box.

selectOptions.label: Yes - No - Cancel
selectOptions.description: Displays Yes, No, and Cancel buttons.

selectOptions.label: Abort - Retry - Ignore
selectOptions.description: Displays Abort, Retry, and Ignore buttons.

fields.name: DefaultButton
fields.label: Default Button
fields.description: The button that is highlighted by default.

selectOptions.label: First Button
selectOptions.description: The first button is the default.

selectOptions.label: Second Button
selectOptions.description: The second button is the default.

selectOptions.label: Third Button
selectOptions.description: The third button is the default.

fields.name: KeepOnTop
fields.label: Keep Message Box Always on Top
fields.description: If true, the message box will stay on top of other windows.

fields.name: AutoClose
fields.label: Close Message Box Automatically
fields.description: If true, the message box will close automatically after the specified timeout.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.label: Timeout (Seconds)
fields.description: The number of seconds after which the message box closes automatically if 'Close Message Box Automatically' is enabled.

fields.name: ButtonPressed
fields.label: Button Pressed
fields.description: True if a button was pressed.
